integrity: Proof gives an analytical infinite-time limit; supplied exact symbolic checker verifies the nonstandard coefficient identities, while finite ODE diagnostics corroborate but do not replace the proof. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The inverse-time energy law holds for fixed positive ecological interaction parameters and all strictly positive initial densities in the strictly positive coexistence regime. It concerns deterministic well-mixed trajectories, not stochastic fixation, finite-population sampling, mutation, spatial coupling or uniform parameter-boundary limits.
title: Universal algebraic damping of matching-type predator–prey composition cycles
